bundle.longDescription: Chat with JV in a selected project workspace, with structured activity. Requires separately installed JV CLI: 0.5.0 or newer on Windows, 0.4.9 or newer on Linux. Linux uses sandboxed permissions; Windows native integration uses trusted-host execution for dedicated worker PCs.
